patterns.note: A persistent, fine-line grid overlay remains fixed in the viewport, creating a structured backdrop for all content and visually segmenting the page.
Monumental, oversized sans-serif typography is used as a sculptural design element, particularly in the footer, extending beyond the viewport boundaries.
A high-contrast palette of bright white, deep charcoal, and a vibrant electric blue is used for accents, branding, and key interactive elements.
The hero section features a multi-layered image collage with elements that parallax at different speeds as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth.
Work highlights are presented in a dynamic, asymmetrical grid of image cards, breaking from the site's otherwise rigid structural grid.

technique_notes: A fixed, viewport-spanning grid overlay is used to provide a consistent structural framework across all content, visually anchoring elements as the page scrolls.

The hero section employs a parallax scrolling effect, where multiple image layers move at varying speeds relative to the scroll, enhancing depth and visual interest, likely using css-keyframes for animation.
Large, bold sans-serif typography is utilized not just for headings but also as a dominant graphic element, particularly in the footer where it scales to fill the screen.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are used for impact, with a monumental display text in the footer (~10x body) acting as a graphic element.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, with most elements having sharp corners, but some image cards feature a very slight rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, characterized by generous padding around sections and within the grid, creating a sense of openness and allowing elements to breathe.

standout: The most distinctive elements are the persistent, fine-line grid overlay that remains fixed as the user scrolls, and the monumental, screen-filling typography in the footer. These elements transform the page into a dynamic, almost architectural canvas, making the site feel highly structured yet visually expansive.
